warnings.provisional_period: This period includes today or future dates and may change.

modules.intro: Cash Flow is always available. Accounting and Profit or Loss are optional and independent, and disabling a module never deletes history.
modules.pnlDisclosure: This is management reporting, not a statutory statement (mapping version {{version}}).
modules.postingGapWarning: Accounting has {{count}} posted journals. Suspending it keeps every journal and marks new cash-flow activity as pending until it is reconciled.
modules.acknowledgeGap: I understand new settlements and transfers will wait for accounting.
modules.enableAccountingHint: After enabling, complete the chart, primary book and mappings before postings can be recorded.

report.disclaimer: This report is management reporting. A category-based report uses cash or issued amounts and is not a statutory accrual income statement.
report.finalizeHint: Finalizing stores an immutable snapshot so later mapping changes cannot rewrite this period.

config.intro: Classify cash-flow categories into Profit or Loss lines. Unmapped categories stay out of the totals and are reported as warnings.
config.mappingsHint: Only operating revenue, cost of sales and operating expenses are pre-suggested. Capital expenditure, loans, taxes and owner movements stay excluded or unclassified until you review them.
config.ledgerUnavailable: Enable Accounting to use the ledger source.
config.passwordHint: Changes are effective-dated and increase the mapping version.
